sn45.11:1.1: Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || Icchāmaham bhikkhave aḍḍhamāsam paṭisalliyituṃ || namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenāti || || Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci Bhagavantam upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena || ||
sn45.11:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi || || Yena svāham bhikkhave vihārena paṭhamābhisambuddho viharāmi || tassa padesena vihāsiṃ || || So evam pajānāmi micchādiṭṭhipaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || sammādiṭṭhipaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || pa || micchāsamādhipaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || sammāsamādhipaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || || Chandapaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || vitakkapaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || saññāpaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || || Chando ca avūpasanto hoti || vitakko ca avūpasanto hoti || saññā ca avūpasantā hoti || tappaccayā vedayitaṃ || || [Chando ca vūpasanto hoti || vitakkā ca avūpasantā honti saññā ca avūpasantā honti || tappaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || || Chando ca vūpasanto hoti || vitakkā ca vūpasantā honti || saññā ca avūpasantā honti || ||] Chando ca vūpasanto hoti || vitakko ca vūpasanto hoti || saññā ca vūpasantā hoti || tappaccayā vedayitaṃ || || Appattassa pattiyā atthi āyāmaṃ || || tasmim pi ṭhāne anuppatte tappaccayā pi vedayitan ti || || 1.2.
